title: ComfortLease Equipment Leases — Leased System Line Sheet
content:
**Line:** ComfortLease Equipment Leases, six leased systems

A ComfortLease lease covers the equipment type of its system, at that system's efficiency rating and within its capacity range. A water heater is added to a lease only where the system shows a water heater bundle as available.

## Systems offered

| Leased system | Equipment type | Brand | Efficiency rating | Capacities offered | Thermostat supplied | Water heater bundle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | gas furnace | Goodman | 96% AFUE | 60,000-100,000 BTU/h | Honeywell T6 Pro Smart | Available |
| ComfortLease Central Air | central air conditioner | Goodman | 15.2 SEER2 | 2.0-5.0 tons | Honeywell T6 Pro Smart | Available |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | heat pump with air handler | Goodman | 15.2 SEER2 / 7.8 HSPF2 | 2.0-5.0 tons | Honeywell T6 Pro Smart | Available |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | gas furnace with central air conditioner | Goodman | 96% AFUE / 15.2 SEER2 | 2.0-5.0 tons | Honeywell T6 Pro Smart | Available |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | heat pump with gas furnace | Goodman | 96% AFUE / 15.2 SEER2 / 7.8 HSPF2 | 2.0-5.0 tons | Honeywell T6 Pro Smart | Available |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | ductless multi-zone heat pump | Mitsubishi Electric | 20.5 SEER2 / 9.5 HSPF2 | 2-4 zones, 18,000-36,000 BTU/h | Mitsubishi kumo cloud controller | Available |

## The same terms, column by column

- **What is leased.** The equipment in a lease is the equipment type in its system's row, of the brand shown, supplied with the thermostat or controller shown.
- **Efficiency.** The equipment is at the efficiency rating in its system's row; where a row shows several ratings separated by a slash, the equipment carries each of them.
- **Size.** The equipment's capacity sits within the range in its system's row. For the ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone the range is stated both as a number of zones (2 to 4) and as a total capacity (18,000 to 36,000 BTU/h).
- **Water heater.** Every system on the line shows the water heater bundle as available, so a water heater may be added to a lease of any of the six systems.

## Reading a row (hypothetical sizes)

| Hypothetical equipment | Leased system | Within the capacity range? |
|---|---|---|
| 3.0-ton central air conditioner | ComfortLease Central Air | Yes — 3.0 tons lies between 2.0 and 5.0 tons |
| 80,000 BTU/h gas furnace | ComfortLease Gas Furnace | Yes — between 60,000 and 100,000 BTU/h |
| 120,000 BTU/h gas furnace | ComfortLease Gas Furnace | No — above 100,000 BTU/h |
| 5-zone ductless installation | ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | No — more than 4 zones |
| 5.0-ton heat pump with air handler | ComfortLease Heat Pump | Yes — 5.0 tons is the top of the range |
